content.summary: This year’s Black Friday deals have launched in waves over the past several weeks, but now the floodgates have officially opened. You can now take advantage of the lowest prices we’ve seen in-store and online for video games, wireless earbuds, TVs, e-readers, robot vacuums, and so much more. We can’t guarantee a deal you’ve had your eye on will last through Cyber Monday; however, if prior years are any indication, most will stick around through the long holiday weekend. As usual, we sorted through thousands of deals to find the ones truly worth sharing, with an eye for the products and services we’ve tested here at The Verge. With prices up across multiple categories due to RAMageddon, some deals may not seem as big as in prior years. For example, Apple’s latest MacBook Air recently fell to its pre-price hike level for the first time since July. That’s a deal to us, and several other discounts are taking a similar shape.
